title: Paite Open Language Data
description:
Open training data for Paite (ISO 639-3: pck), a Zomi language of Manipur and Mizoram (India), Myanmar, and Bangladesh: a complete Paite Bible aligned with the World English Bible, an English-Paite dictionary, hymn lyrics, native-speaker corrections, ready-to-train JSONL files with fixed splits, and an everyday-Paite benchmark for AI models.

Rights differ by part; see LICENSE in the repository.
